title: Add paginated run query and filtering contract
summary: Introduce PageRequest pagination, status filtering, and timestamp bounds to the public run query contract.
problemStatement: The current run query contract returns unbounded lists without filter parameters, risking excessive payload sizes and preventing efficient cursor-based run retrieval.

inScope: Public PageRequest and PageResponse query types in @bflow/contracts
Cursor-based pagination with limit bounds (1 to 500)
Run status and time-range query filter criteria

acceptanceCriteria.description: PageRequestSchema validates cursor strings and clamps limit between 1 and 500 items.
RunQueryFilterSchema validates optional status filters and ISO datetime range bounds while rejecting undeclared properties.
Unpaginated query requests remain valid and produce conforming RunQueryResult collections without backward incompatibility.

architectureNotes: Extend @bflow/contracts with additive PageRequestSchema and RunQueryFilterSchema definitions. Ensure zero breaking changes for existing query callers.
securityConsiderations: Enforce maximum page size limit of 500 to prevent memory exhaustion DoS; sanitize opaque cursor strings to prevent data leakage.
rollbackPlan: Revert contract additions and rebuild packages/contracts; existing clients remain fully operational because new fields are optional.

tddDecision.rationale: Public API contract changes require schema boundary tests before export
verifiableConditions: Schema validation tests fail prior to export implementation

verifiableConditions: Schema validation tests fail prior to export implementation

testNames: RunQueryFilterSchema field validation and strict rejection

functionalRequirements: Export PageRequestSchema validating cursor string and limit between 1 and 500.
Export RunQueryFilterSchema validating optional status and ISO datetime range filters.
Support backwards-compatible query execution when pagination parameters are omitted.
sdd.proposedTestStrategy: TDD unit tests validating schema boundary conditions followed by integration tests ensuring backward compatibility with unpaginated query fixtures.
sdd.designProposal: Define composable pagination and filter Zod schemas in @bflow/contracts with optional fields, preserving existing query signatures.
technicalConstraints: Strict TypeScript typing with exactOptionalPropertyTypes and verbatimModuleSyntax.
Clamp limit to maximum 500 items per page.
Preserve existing caller signatures without breaking changes.
apiDataContracts: RunQueryFilterSchema: { status?: RunStatus, startedAfter?: IsoDateTime, startedBefore?: IsoDateTime }
Page<RunSummary>: { items: readonly RunSummary[], nextCursor?: string }
risksAndTradeoffs: Opaque cursor tokens prevent client coupling to internal database primary keys.
Additive contract surface slightly increases bundle size in exchange for strong runtime validation.
